Item: doc-outline
**Actual:** fail
Story:
id: doc-outline
title: Document Outline On Demand
as_a: Claude User
i_want: Claude to list the headings of a shared Google Doc when I ask for its outline
so_that: I can see how the document is organised before I read it
status: PLANNED
acceptance_criteria:
    - id: AC-1
      description: Claude must display every heading of a shared Google Doc, in document order, when the Claude User asks for its outline.
      steps:
        - given:
            - a Google Doc with 3 headings is shared with the Claude User
        - when:
            - the Claude User asks Claude to outline the document
        - then:
            - Claude displays an outline of 3 headings
    - id: AC-2
      description: Claude must display the message "This document has no headings" and offer a summary instead when the Claude User asks for the outline of a document without headings.
      steps:
        - given:
            - a Google Doc with no headings is shared with the Claude User
        - when:
            - the Claude User asks Claude to outline the document
        - then:
            - Claude displays the message "This document has no headings"
            - and: Claude offers to summarise the document instead
    - id: AC-3
      description: Claude must display the message "This document is not shared with your account" when the Claude User asks for the outline of a document they cannot open.
      steps:
        - given:
            - a Google Doc that is not shared with the Claude User
        - when:
            - the Claude User asks Claude to outline the document
        - then:
            - Claude displays the message "This document is not shared with your account"

Findings:

- AC-1 given step "a Google Doc with 3 headings is shared with the Claude User": linked to shared document; threshold 9; scores {"shared document":10}; reason: A Google Doc holding a stated number of headings (3) and shared with the Claude User's account — a plain instance of the setup the concept states.; other block: none

- AC-1 when step "the Claude User asks Claude to outline the document": linked to outline request; threshold 9; scores {"outline request":10}; reason: The Claude User asks Claude, in the conversation, for the outline of the Google Doc — a plain instance of the outline request.; other block: none

- AC-1 then step "Claude displays an outline of 3 headings": linked to reply; threshold 9; scores {"reply":10}; reason: Claude's reply lists an outline of a stated number of headings (3); 'outline' is glossary-defined as the document's headings in document order, so this is a plain instance of the reply concept.; other block: none

- AC-2 given step "a Google Doc with no headings is shared with the Claude User": linked to shared document; threshold 9; scores {"shared document":10}; reason: A Google Doc with 'no' headings shared with the Claude User's account — the concept expressly covers 'no' meaning none.; other block: none

- AC-2 when step "the Claude User asks Claude to outline the document": linked to outline request; threshold 9; scores {"outline request":10}; reason: The Claude User asks Claude, in the conversation, for the outline of the Google Doc — a plain instance of the outline request.; other block: none

- AC-2 then step "Claude displays the message \"This document has no headings\"": linked to reply; threshold 9; scores {"reply":10}; reason: Claude's reply is exactly a stated message, the second alternative the reply concept names.; other block: none

- AC-2 then step "Claude offers to summarise the document instead": no concept of then reaches the threshold; threshold 9; scores {"reply":4}; reason: An observable then-kind outcome, but offering to summarise is neither a listing of a stated number of headings nor exactly a stated message; the closed reply concept admits only those two variations, so this falls outside it.; other block: none

- AC-3 given step "a Google Doc that is not shared with the Claude User": linked to shared document; threshold 9; scores {"shared document":9}; reason: A Google Doc not shared with the Claude User's account restates the concept's second alternative, that the account cannot open it, in other words.; other block: none

- AC-3 when step "the Claude User asks Claude to outline the document": linked to outline request; threshold 9; scores {"outline request":10}; reason: The Claude User asks Claude, in the conversation, for the outline of the Google Doc — a plain instance of the outline request.; other block: none

- AC-3 then step "Claude displays the message \"This document is not shared with your account\"": linked to reply; threshold 9; scores {"reply":10}; reason: Claude's reply is exactly a stated message, the second alternative the reply concept names.; other block: none
